title: bg target not aligned on client
body:
in the 3.2.0.x and 3.1.0.x client app the target always remains that of the active profile. on androidaps master it is varied with autosens but on the client it always remains the same. Is it a mistake or is it intentional?
on client app it changes only if temp-target enable (from master or from client, it's the same)

comments.body: Sure! As soon as there is an opportunity for a target modified by autosens I will immediately take screenshots. Thank you.
There were options `sensitivity rises target` and `resistance lowers target` - only those could affect target by sensitivity. Do you have those enabled?
Yes. They are enabled and in fact on master it's ok (raise and decrease for autosens). In NSclient i see always only target from current profile.

> can you provide screenshot?
